hypothesis: Y039 showed that relocating cell coordinates without consistent decoding disrupts persistent placement. Test the independent key-identity side: daily remapping of observed motif IDs may corrupt cache association unless matching, storage and evaluation consistently use physical motif identity.
freeze: Exact bijections, inverse functions, regimes, policies, split and classification criteria fixed before first-use. All alternative outcomes archived. No threshold tuning or accepted-ref edits.
base: Exact Y039/Y036 circular radius-two placement graph, seven active of sixteen motif identities and cells, max nine inactive cached assignments, eight episodes per seed, collision as inherited. No new memory or cell capacity.
inverse: additive key=(observed-3*seed-5*episode) mod16; affine key=13*(observed-3*seed-3*episode) mod16. The codec is deterministic, from currently provided seed/episode; no learned semantic oracle. Identity-aware mode explicitly decodes to canonical frame for matching+cache, then re-encodes outputs. Raw mode retains numeric observed aliases.
primary: For each regime/policy/frame report heldout total physical returning-key placement churn and physical assignment mismatches per episode relative to canonical reference; cache writes/key-count parity, matching cardinality7, legal preference count and search calls. Per-seed original results retained. Raw alias cache write-count and occupancy differences are separately recorded; only reference-versus-aware writes and occupancy are required to match identically. Do not infer that key aliases alone, rather than associated bookkeeping drift, explain any raw outcome.
classification: KEY_FRAME_CONFOUND if BOTH identity-aware transforms have zero physical assignment mismatches on all heldout comparisons AND at least one raw moving transform produces mismatches and altered physical churn. PARTIAL if identity-aware has fewer mismatches than raw but not zero; NO_CONFIRMED_CONFOUND otherwise. If inverse bijections, frame-consistency or Hall checks fail, INVALID and stop.
controls: Independent exact invertibility asserts for all 16 identities each episode
Physical motif labels known only as reference for evaluator, but inverse transform is public algorithmic configuration for aware policy; no extra observations

claim_limit: Finite synthetic identity-coordinate equivariance; not evidence of learned semantic identity, general memory or real-world intelligence.
